response:
I am so incredibly sorry for your loss. Losing a baby is a profound and devastating experience, and it is completely understandable that you are in immense pain right now. Please know that whatever you are feeling—whether it is deep sadness, anger, numbness, or exhaustion—is completely valid. There is no right or wrong way to grieve, and there is no timeline for healing from such a heartbreaking loss. 

During this difficult time, please be as gentle with yourself as possible. It can be helpful to lean on trusted loved ones or connect with a support group for parents who have experienced infant or pregnancy loss, as sharing with others who truly understand can offer a small sense of comfort. You might also consider reaching out to a grief counselor to help you navigate these overwhelming emotions. Please take things one moment at a time, and remember that it is okay to ask for professional help when the weight feels too heavy to carry alone.
